Grindworm - Official Trailer
Grindworm is a short horror game where you're buried alive in a collapsed underground mine, and your only hope for survival is an old mining machine. Workplace safety rules no longer apply. Just remember: DON'T. STOP. DIGGING. Grindworm will be available on Steam in Q4 2026.

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Mini Motorways - Official Update Trailer
It's time to hit the road in Rome. Mini Motorways is a strategy simulation game about designing the road map for a growing city. Build a traffic network, one road at a time, to create a bustling metropolis. Redesign your roads and place your motorways to get everyone where they need to go. How long can you keep the city moving? The new trailer for Mini Motorways showcases what's coming with the new update, where you'll build roads in Rome. Mini Motorways is out now on Apple Arcade, Steam, and Nintendo Switch. The new update is coming in Winter 2026.

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Xbox Seeks Partner to Help Arkane Lyon Finish Marvel's Blade - IGN Daily Fix
In today's Daily Fix:
Arkane Lyon is still plugging away at Marvel's Blade, but the studio may be on the chopping block if Microsoft can't find a buyer for the studio by the end of the year. Microsoft is also looking for a partner to "support" the development of the game as it nears completion. That support could be in extra financing for the studio. Marvel's Blade doesn't have a firm release date but it is expected to be out sometime next year. In other news, a hacker has claimed a $50,000 bounty from Sony for reporting an exploit, but has now drawn the ire of others in the PS5 homebrew scene. By reporting the bug, he apparently has wasted months of work by the homebrew community in getting Linux to run on the PS5.

Dancing with Ghosts - Official Early Access Launch Trailer
Dancing with Ghosts is out now in Early Access. Watch the Dancing with Ghosts early access launch trailer for this narrative game about learning to live after loss. Befriend a cheery ghost and earn the good karma that recovers her memories by dancing, making roti, and helping your neighbors around a lively Thai river village, finding healing in every connection you make.

Crop - Official Overview Trailer
Get a closer look at Crop in this new trailer for the upcoming gritty farming thriller where your safety depends on the yield. Bound to a dying farm, you must dig, plant, irrigate, and cut your way through the decay. Uncover buried secrets, both in the soil and quietly brewing within the village. The only way out is through the harvest. Crop will be available on PC (Steam and GOG) in 2027.

Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced - Official Final Major Content Update
Get a look at the Final Major Content Update Video for Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced, a remake of the hit entry in the stealth action-adventure franchise set in the age of piracy, developed by Ubisoft. Players can get a taste of what's in store with the game's final content offering, including New Game+, Nightmare Mode, brand-new takedowns, and tons of unlockable rewards to enjoy. The Final Major Content Update for Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced is launching on October 27 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).

HumanitZ - Official 1.1 Major Update Trailer
Check out the trailer for the HumanitZ 1.1 Major Update. HumanitZ is an open-world zombie survival game where you scavenge, craft, build, and fight off the hordes, solo or with friends. The new update brings recruitable survivors, a new Headshot-Only Mode, and the ability to hunt yourself down. If you die after being bitten by a zeek, you'll turn into one! Come back, and you'll have to track down your former self, now a zeek, to get your gear back. The update also added tons of new features and a Halloween Event with themed quests, cosmetics, and weapons.

Marvel Cosmic Invasion - Official The Siege of Castle Doom Game Mode Trailer
Take a look at The Siege of Castle Doom Game Mode Trailer for Marvel Cosmic Invasion, a 2D action beat 'em up game developed by Tribute Games. Players must stop Victor von Doom's plans to activate the deadly Cosmic Inductor in the new DLC game mode by gathering Battery Cells, choosing paths, and stopping Doom. The Siege of Castle Doom Game Mode for Marvel Cosmic Invasion is launching on November 10 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).

text:
Why Sword of Legends Needs to Be On Your Radar & Looks at Chasing Kaleidorider and Animula Nook
IGN's Nick Limon went hands on with Sword of Legends, Chasing Kaleidorider, and Animula Nook. Sword of Legends is a new single-player action RPG that uses Unreal Engine 5 to immerse players in a world inspired by Chinese myth and folklore. For those looking to add a dash of romance to their life, there's magical girl dating-sim Chasing Kaleidorider. And if you want something cozy, there's Animula Nook.

Presented by Tencent.
